title: Healthcheck Probe Config Compiler
description: Compiles Kubernetes liveness, readiness, and startup probe configurations. Enforces: each referenced port exists on the target container, probe schema validates, all thresholds are positive integers, both readiness and liveness defined.

error_codes.PC001: probe-config-spec.json missing or invalid — required: containerPorts[], probes{}
error_codes.PC002: Probe references a port that does not exist on the container
error_codes.PC003: Probe schema is invalid — httpGet, tcpSocket, exec, or grpc must be complete
error_codes.PC004: Probe threshold or timing field is not a positive integer
error_codes.PC005: Both liveness and readiness probes are not defined (or exemption missing)
